## ✅ Checklist

### Code Quality
- [ ] 📝 My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] 🔍 I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] 💬 I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] 📚 I have updated the documentation accordingly
- [ ] ❌ My changes generate no new warnings

### Testing
- [ ] 🧪 I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] ✅ New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] 📊 I have checked that code coverage doesn't decrease

### Dependencies & Security
- [ ] 🔒 I have checked for security vulnerabilities
- [ ] 📦 I have updated dependencies if needed
- [ ] 🔐 I have not introduced any secrets or sensitive data

### Performance
- [ ] ⚡ I have considered performance implications
- [ ] 📈 I have checked for potential memory leaks
- [ ] 🎯 I have optimized any database queries if applicable

### Database
- [ ] 🗄️ I have added tests for database changes (if applicable)
- [ ] 📝 I have documented database changes (if applicable)
- [ ] ⚠️ I have considered migration rollback procedures (if applicable)
